transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize the duty roster for the three uncovered exercise shifts — Tuesday 0600-1400, Wednesday 1400-2200, and Thursday 2200-0600 — I need to confirm a couple of things. Per the standing Monday personnel-sync routine, I need each of you — the Alpha Company commander, Bravo Company commander, and S-1 officer — to report any roster changes before I publish the schedule. Once I have that confirmation, we can assign Alpha, Bravo, and the battalion support staff each to one shift, and I'll sign off on the final roster with named shift handoffs for every assignment. Who'd like to start?

transcript.text: I need to report a roster change: Alpha Company's only currently qualified exercise-cell supervisor is Sgt. Ellis, and he is available only for the Tuesday 0600-1400 shift. He begins an instructor course Tuesday afternoon, so he cannot cover Wednesday or Thursday. I confirmed the course enrollment this morning, but the updated availability is not yet reflected on the battalion roster.
